answers.evidence:
All tests pass:

| Input | Output | Expected | Notes |
|-------|--------|----------|-------|
| `0` | `1` | `1` | Base case (0! = 1 by definition) |
| `1` | `1` | `1` | Edge of the loop (range(2,2) is empty) |
| `5` | `120` | `120` | Normal case |
| `10` | `3628800` | `3628800` | Larger value |
| `-1` | `ValueError` | — | Negative input correctly rejected |
| `3.5` | `TypeError` | — | Non-integer correctly rejected |

The function uses an iterative approach (`O(n)` time, `O(1)` space), avoiding recursion depth issues. The loop runs from `2` to `n` inclusive — correct even for `n = 0` and `n = 1` where `range(2, n+1)` is empty, returning the initial `result = 1`.
